about: The fixture is bench/fixture/logs/, built by bench/fixture/build.mjs: the Ankh-Morpork clacks as a rotated JSON-lines set (clacks.log, .1, .2.gz, 8 to 10 November 2026), a web access log (gate.access.log) and a Python-style log with tracebacks (watch.log), with a token and an email address planted to check the masking. The questions are the kinds the kit is for: which errors happen most and which are new, when one first appeared, what happened around a time or a request id, when a burst started. The shots (do) call no model; their expectations were checked against the fixture's output on 2026-11-21. The q questions are for the model and have not been run on one. Run from the kit's folder so the relative paths resolve.
